escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now comes the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over six hundred and fifteen million views. Three lists, three crowns, and one video that refused to leave any list alone. Which one? You'll find out at the very end. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The world rules: only the top three of every list from every continent make it here, with the same numbers from this Sunday's world tour. One video per creator on each list. Every number comes from the official YouTube API. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos in the world. Opening the countdown at number ten, from Spain, YoSoyDander, with a Short of just nineteen seconds posted six days ago. Over fifteen million views. Nineteen seconds, fifteen million plays. And this is only the floor of the list.
Number nine, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, asking: “Is This The Best Way To Recycle Plastic?”. A forty-nine second Short with over twenty million views in four days.

At number eight, from the United Kingdom, DAZN Football, with “2026 Ballon d'Or Red Carpet Pre Show”. Over twenty-one million views. This is a video over seventy-two minutes long, and it got there in just one day. Football doesn't wait.
Number seven, from the United States, Sofia Pevidor, with a fifty-seven second Short posted six days ago. Over twenty-one million views, and more than five hundred and thirteen thousand likes.

Number six, from the United States, Conexwest, with “One shipping container. Two levels of living.”. Over twenty-four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and fifteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. Remember this name. It is not done with us today.

Halfway there. Number five, from the United States, a channel with over sixty-two million subscribers: IShowSpeed, with “iSHOWSPEED vs DUDE PERFECT GAUNTLET!”. A forty-nine second Short. Over thirty million views. A giant of the platform, and still only number five.

Number four, Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over thirty million views, just ahead of IShowSpeed. And get this: it's a channel with about eighty-eight thousand subscribers. Everyday family life, beating one of the biggest names on YouTube. Now, the podium.

Bronze medal, ARTIST JOYBOY, with a twenty-one second drawing Short. Over thirty-three million views, on a channel with about sixty-seven thousand subscribers. But two videos are still ahead, and the gap is big.

Silver medal, from India, Samay Raina, with a new episode of his show, a video over fifty minutes long posted just two days ago. Over forty-four million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. Fifty minutes, and still that pace. Only one video in the world did better.

And here it is. Number one most viewed on the planet this week, from India, Shivapriya Official, with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”. Over forty-seven million views. A Short of just twenty seconds, right in Diwali season. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty-four thousand subscribers. A small channel, on top of the whole world.

Views tell you who watched. Comments tell you who couldn't stay quiet. Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos in the world. Number ten, from the United States, Jenny Devil, with a video over twenty-three minutes long posted three days ago. Over eight thousand comments, and over one point five million views.

Number nine, from Egypt, Mahmoud Zayed, with a twenty-three second Short posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments, and over three point two million views. Twenty-three seconds, and the comment section exploded.

At number eight, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a gaming video over forty-nine minutes long. Over fourteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: fifteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.
Number seven, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani Vlogs, showing how his candies are made. Over sixteen thousand comments, and over eight point five million views.
Number six, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video over twenty minutes long posted four days ago. Over twenty-five thousand comments, and over fifteen million views.

Number five, from India, Free Fire India Official, with “FREE FIRE INDIA IS HERE!”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments, and it got there in less than a day. Over five point three million views. Gamers were waiting for this one.

Number four, from India, What Factzz, with a twenty-seven second Short. Over forty-five thousand comments, and almost ten million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty-seven thousand subscribers. Now hold on, because the next three are separated by just a few hundred comments.
Bronze medal, from India, Samay Raina, again. Yes, the silver medal of the views list is back. Over forty-five thousand five hundred comments. Just fifty-nine more than What Factzz. A photo finish.

Silver medal, from the United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with an episode featuring President Zelenskyy, a video over one hundred and nine minutes long. Over forty-five thousand seven hundred comments, and over five point one million views. Almost two hours, and the conversation never stopped. But one video was in a league of its own.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented in the world, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, exploring three spooky places found on Google Maps in a video over thirty-three minutes long. Over fifty-five thousand comments, almost ten thousand more than second place. Over eighteen million views. The king of the conversation this week.

And the last list, the one that decides the final crown: the ten most liked videos in the world. Number ten, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First”. Over three hundred and forty-nine thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers.

Number nine, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over four hundred and seven thousand likes, and over ten million views. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-four thousand subscribers.
Number eight, a familiar face: Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over four hundred and forty-one thousand likes. Number four in views, and now on the likes list too.
Number seven, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, also back from the comments list. Over four hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes, on over fifteen million views.
Number six, from Pakistan, Heemi, with a sixteen second Short. Over five hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes, and over nineteen million views.

Number five, from the United States, Sean Andrew, with “I Tested the Famous Pirate Eye Patch Myth!”. A forty-seven second Short. Over five hundred and forty-seven thousand likes, and over fifteen million views. And from here on, the race gets tight: the next three are separated by about seven thousand likes.

Number four, from the United States, IShowSpeed, with “iSHOWSPEED vs DUDE PERFECT GAUNTLET!”. Over six hundred and eighty-two thousand likes. Number five in views, and number four here. Now, the podium.

Bronze medal, from India, Kitchen CureAI, with a family kitchen story posted six days ago. Over six hundred and eighty-four thousand likes, and over sixteen million views. Just over two thousand likes ahead of IShowSpeed.

Silver medal, from the United States, Conexwest. I told you to remember this name. The shipping container home, number six in views, now silver in likes. Over six hundred and eighty-nine thousand likes, on a channel with about one hundred and fifteen thousand subscribers. Second on the planet. But the number one is on another level.

And here it is. Number one most liked in the world, from India, Samay Raina. Over one point two million likes, more than five hundred and forty thousand ahead of second place. Silver in views, bronze in comments, and now gold in likes: the only video of the week on all three world lists. The complete video of the week.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
